# DiskScope 0.1.0
Initial public release for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later.
- Explore storage with the folder hierarchy, rectangular treemap and circular sunburst. - Reopen cached scans, refresh a selected subtree, and review cleanup candidates in the Collector. - Find permission guidance, saved-location recovery, scan issues and app identity in Settings → Privacy & Access. - Reuse saved parent-folder access for child locations and keep unavailable locations recoverable without repeated access-help alerts. - Check for signed updates through Sparkle in DiskScope → Check for Updates.
This free release is self-signed and unnotarized. Follow the installation guide if macOS requires first-launch approval. Full Disk Access is optional; macOS controls consent and some protected locations can remain unavailable. Moving from an older ad-hoc build to this signing identity may require authorisation again.
[Installation guide](https://mes30004e.github.io/DiskScope/#installation) · [Permissions guide](https://mes30004e.github.io/DiskScope/permissions.html)
